description: CI/CD pipeline and build optimization: Add GitHub Actions workflow for automated builds, Vercel preview deploys, and Convex deploy steps. Add production build optimizations (chunk splitting, compression hints).
steps: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with: pnpm install, lint (pnpm lint), type-check and build (pnpm build), with caching for pnpm store. Trigger on push to main and PRs.

Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml with: production deploy steps (comments/docs only since tokens needed) - Vercel deploy via vercel --prod, Convex deploy via npx convex deploy. Trigger on push to main only. Include environment secrets placeholders (VERCEL_TOKEN, VERCEL_ORG_ID, VERCEL_PROJECT_ID, CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY).

Update vite.config.ts to add build optimizations: manual chunk splitting (vendor chunk for react/react-dom/react-router-dom, convex chunk for convex, firebase chunk for firebase), source map generation for production debugging.
Add a proper version to package.json (change from 0.0.0 to 1.0.0).
Update DEPLOY.md to document the CI/CD pipeline and reference the GitHub Actions workflows.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds with the updated vite.config.ts
.github/workflows/ci.yml exists with correct pnpm build steps
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm it succeeds with chunk splitting producing separate vendor/convex/firebase chunks in dist/assets/
